meta.description: All advantages (Vorteile) for TDE4/DSA4.1. Costs are in GP at character creation. Advantages marked auto_only can only be granted by race/culture/profession packages, not freely chosen. [G] = Gift (natural talent, advances like a talent). [M] = Magical advantage.

advantages.name: Noble Birth

effects.description: Hero is treated as noble; social bonuses in aristocratic contexts
Access to noble social circles; heraldic recognition

advantages.description: The hero descends from a noble family. They enjoy social advantages in aristocratic contexts, have access to higher social circles, and may claim a noble title appropriate to their culture.

advantages.name: Academic Training

effects.description: Formal academic education; bonuses to lore talents and access to scholarly resources
Access to academic script and language skills

advantages.description: The hero has received formal academic education at a university or similar institution. They gain access to scholarly resources, academic networks, and bonuses to appropriate lore talents.

advantages.name: Age Resistance

effects.description: Hero ages more slowly and suffers fewer penalties from aging

advantages.description: The hero ages more gracefully than normal, suffering fewer penalties from the effects of aging.

advantages.name: Astral Regeneration I

effects.description: Regenerate 1 additional ASP per rest phase per level

advantages.description: The magic user's astral energy regenerates more quickly during rest. Level I: +1 ASP per rest; Level II: +2 ASP; Level III: +3 ASP. Cost: 4/8/12 GP.

advantages.name: Astral Power

effects.description: Each GP spent grants 1 additional ASP permanently

advantages.description: The spellcaster has exceptional astral reserves. Each GP spent provides 1 additional permanent Astral Point.

advantages.name: Enduring

effects.description: Each GP spent grants 2 additional Endurance Points

advantages.description: The hero has exceptional stamina. Each GP spent provides 2 additional permanent Endurance Points.

advantages.name: Equipment Advantage

effects.description: Hero can spend additional starting money equal to SO × 2 ducats

advantages.description: The hero starts with additional funds or equipment worth SO × 2 ducats beyond normal starting money.

advantages.name: Balance

effects.description: Knockdown ST test 2 points easier; bonuses to acrobatic balance tests

advantages.description: The hero has exceptional sense of balance. Knockdown resistance is improved by 2; benefits in any situation requiring balance.

advantages.name: Aptitude (single combat/physical talent)

effects.description: Maximum TP for this talent increases to highest attribute + 5 instead of + 3
Advancement column moves one step easier

advantages.description: The hero has a natural gift for a single combat or physical talent. Maximum starting TP increases to +5 above highest attribute (instead of +3), and the advancement column improves by one step. Cost: 6 GP for combat/physical talents.

advantages.name: Aptitude (single other talent)
advantages.description: The hero has a natural gift for a single non-combat talent. Maximum starting TP increases to +5 above highest attribute, and advancement column improves. Cost: 4 GP.

advantages.name: Aptitude (combat/physical talent group)
advantages.description: Aptitude for an entire combat or physical talent group (30 GP).

advantages.name: Aptitude (other talent group)
advantages.description: Aptitude for an entire non-combat talent group (20 GP).

advantages.name: Aptitude (all melee talents)
advantages.description: Aptitude for all melee combat talents (20 GP).

advantages.name: Aptitude (all ranged talents)
advantages.description: Aptitude for all ranged combat talents (15 GP).

advantages.name: Aptitude (languages)
advantages.description: Aptitude for all language and script talents (10 GP).

advantages.name: Special Item

effects.description: Hero receives one large/valuable item from their profession's special possession list (e.g. horse, boat). Cannot be immediately sold.

advantages.description: The hero possesses one significant item from their profession's special possession list (e.g., a proven horse for Messengers, or a masterwork lockpick set for Burglars). This item cannot be immediately sold.

advantages.name: Twilight Sight

effects.description: Can see in dim light and twilight conditions as if in daylight

advantages.description: The hero can see in near-darkness and twilight as well as others see in daylight. Dwarves and Elves receive this automatically.

advantages.name: Iron

effects.description: Wound Threshold increased by 2

advantages.description: The hero's body is exceptionally tough. Their Wound Threshold is increased by 2, meaning they require much more damage to suffer a wound.

advantages.name: Fairy Friend

effects.description: Neutral or positive relations with fairies and nature spirits; they do not automatically flee or attack

advantages.description: The hero has a natural rapport with fairies and nature spirits. These beings treat the hero as neutral or friendly rather than with suspicion or hostility.

advantages.name: Fleet

effects.description: Base Speed (GS) increased by 1

advantages.description: The hero moves faster than average. Base Speed (GS) is increased by 1.

advantages.name: Educated

effects.description: Each GP spent grants one additional language or knowledge talent at starting value

advantages.description: The hero has additional education. Each GP spent provides one additional language or knowledge talent at its starting value.

advantages.name: Danger Instinct

effects.description: A Gift (Gabe) that works like a talent; can test against it to sense danger before it becomes apparent

advantages.description: A natural supernatural gift. Functions as a talent (starting value, can be advanced). The hero can test against Danger Instinct to sense approaching danger before others notice it. Can only be acquired at character creation.

advantages.name: Luck

effects.description: Hero gains Luck Points usable to re-roll failed tests a limited number of times

advantages.description: The hero is blessed with exceptional luck. Gains Luck Points that can be spent to re-roll failed tests.

advantages.name: Lucky Gambler

effects.description: Bonuses to gambling and games of chance

advantages.description: The hero has a knack for games of chance and gambling, receiving bonuses to related tests.

advantages.name: Good-Looking

effects.description: Bonuses to Seduce, Persuade, and other social tests where appearance matters

advantages.description: The hero is notably attractive, receiving social bonuses in situations where appearance matters.

advantages.name: Good Memory I

effects.description: Eases all tests involving memorization and recall

advantages.description: The hero has an exceptionally good memory. Level I (7 GP) and Level II (12 GP) provide increasing bonuses to memory and recall tests.

advantages.name: Outstanding Balance

effects.description: Knockdown ST test 4 points easier; exceptional balance in all situations

advantages.description: Superior version of Balance. Knockdown resistance improves by 4. Cannot be combined with Balance.

advantages.name: Outstanding Attribute

effects.description: Allows a single attribute to exceed the normal creation maximum

advantages.description: Allows one attribute to exceed the normally allowed creation maximum. Cost varies by attribute.

advantages.name: Outstanding Sense

effects.description: One sense (hearing, sight, smell, taste, or touch) is exceptionally acute

advantages.description: The hero has an exceptionally acute sense. Choose one sense at acquisition.

advantages.name: Outstanding Appearance

effects.description: Significant social bonuses; may cause strong reactions (envy, infatuation, etc.)

advantages.description: The hero is strikingly, exceptionally beautiful or handsome. Provides major social bonuses but may also attract unwanted attention.

advantages.name: Heat Resistance

effects.description: Immune to non-magical heat effects; reduced damage from heat-based magical attacks

advantages.description: The hero is exceptionally resistant to extreme heat and hot environments.

advantages.name: Vigor

effects.description: Each 2 GP spent grants 1 additional Vitality Point

advantages.description: The hero has exceptional life force. Each 2 GP spent provides 1 additional permanent Vitality Point.

advantages.name: High Resistance to Magic

effects.description: Each 2 GP spent grants 1 additional point of Resistance to Magic (RM)

advantages.description: The hero is exceptionally resistant to magical effects. Each 2 GP spent adds 1 RM.

advantages.name: Immunity to Poison (individual)
advantages.description: Complete immunity to a single specific poison.

advantages.name: Immunity to Poison (group)
advantages.description: Complete immunity to a group of related poisons (e.g., all mineral poisons, all plant alkaloids).

advantages.name: General Poison Immunity
advantages.description: Complete immunity to all non-magical poisons.

advantages.name: Immunity to Disease (individual)
advantages.description: Complete immunity to a single specific disease.

advantages.name: Disease Immunity
advantages.description: Complete immunity to all non-magical diseases.

advantages.name: Mental Compass

effects.description: Innate sense of cardinal direction; bonuses to Orientation tests

advantages.description: The hero has an innate sense of direction, always knowing which way is north and gaining bonuses to Orientation tests.

advantages.name: Cold Resistance

effects.description: Resistant to extreme cold and cold-based effects

advantages.description: The hero is exceptionally resistant to extreme cold and frigid environments.

advantages.name: Battle Frenzy

effects.description: Bonus to Initiative and combat stamina when entering a battle frenzy state

advantages.description: The hero can enter a battle frenzy, gaining bonuses to combat effectiveness at the cost of reduced defensive capacity and potential loss of control.

advantages.name: Kobold Friend

effects.description: Kobolds and house spirits are friendly to the hero

advantages.description: The hero has a natural rapport with kobolds and house spirits. These mischievous beings treat the hero favorably.

advantages.name: Magic Sense

effects.description: A Gift (Gabe) that functions as a talent; can sense nearby magical auras and active spells

advantages.description: A natural Gift for detecting magic. Functions as a talent with a starting value. The hero can sense nearby magical auras, active spells, and enchanted items. Can only be acquired at creation.

advantages.name: Master Craft
advantages.gp_cost_formula: 1 GP per talent (standard) or 5 GP (magical version)

effects.description: The magical version allows ASP to be spent to ease talent tests. Standard version provides exceptional craft proficiency.

advantages.description: Standard version (1 GP): exceptional crafting proficiency in a specific artisan talent. Magical version (5 GP) for magical dabblers: allows spending ASP to ease talent tests. Used by quarter-casters instead of full spells.

advantages.name: Resistance to Poison (individual)
advantages.description: The hero is resistant (not immune) to a single specific poison, halving its effects.

advantages.name: Resistance to Poison (group)
advantages.description: Resistance to a group of related poisons (e.g., mineral poisons).

advantages.name: General Poison Resistance
advantages.description: Resistance to all non-magical poisons.

advantages.name: Resistance to Diseases
advantages.description: The hero is resistant to all diseases, making infections less severe and easier to overcome.

advantages.name: Direction Sense

effects.description: Bonuses to Orientation tests in familiar terrain types

advantages.description: The hero has an exceptional sense of direction, gaining bonuses to Orientation tests.

advantages.name: Snake Person

effects.description: Exceptional flexibility; can contort body in ways normally impossible
Bonuses to escape from bonds, squeeze through tight spaces

advantages.description: The hero's body is extraordinarily flexible, allowing for contortionist feats. Bonuses to Acrobatics, Binding/Escape, and similar tests.

advantages.name: Fast Healing

effects.description: Regenerate 1 additional VP per rest per level

advantages.description: The hero heals faster than normal. Level I (+1 VP/rest, 5 GP), Level II (+2 VP/rest, 10 GP), Level III (+3 VP/rest, 15 GP). Note: wiki shows this as 5/10/15 GP; BRW may vary.

advantages.name: Guardian Spirit

effects.description: A protective spirit provides occasional warnings of danger or minor magical assistance

advantages.description: A guardian spirit watches over the hero, providing occasional warnings. Used by magical dabblers (quarter-casters) as one of their special magical abilities.

advantages.name: Hard to Enspell

effects.description: Domination and Transformation spells targeting this hero receive a Difficulty Increase of 3 points

advantages.description: Domination and Transformation spells cast at the hero receive a Difficulty Increase of 3 points.

advantages.name: Social Chameleon

effects.description: Hero blends in easily across social classes; reduced suspicion when acting out of expected social role

advantages.description: The hero adapts easily to different social contexts, blending in with nobles or commoners alike.

advantages.name: Supernatural Aptitude

effects.description: A specific innate magical ability for magical dabblers (quarter-casters)

advantages.description: A supernatural power for magical dabblers (quarter-casters). Each use/activation costs 1 GP. These replace full spells for dabblers.

advantages.name: Connections

effects.description: The hero has a valuable contact in society who can provide help, information, or resources

advantages.description: The hero has a connection to an important person. Cost equals 1/3 of the contact's Social Standing rounded up. Higher SO contacts are more expensive but more influential.

advantages.name: Quarter Caster

effects.description: Access to Supernatural Aptitudes, Master Craft (magical), and Guardian Spirit; negative ASP (not a full caster)

advantages.description: The hero is a magical dabbler (Viertelzauberer). Gains access to Supernatural Aptitudes, magical Master Craft, and Guardian Spirit. Does NOT gain full spell access. Standard cost is 3 GP; an enhanced version costs 5 GP.

advantages.name: Full Caster

effects.description: Access to the full spell system; Astral Points; spell advancement

advantages.description: The hero is a full spellcaster (Vollzauberer). This is automatically granted by the Magician profession and by the Elf race. Cannot be freely selected; must come from race or profession.

advantages.name: Euphonic Voice

effects.description: Exceptionally pleasant voice; bonuses to Sing, Persuade, and performance tests

advantages.description: The hero has a beautiful, melodious voice. Bonuses to Sing, Persuade, and any test where a pleasant voice matters.

advantages.name: Tough Dog

effects.description: Hero continues fighting effectively even at very low VP; reduced penalties from wounds

advantages.description: The hero is exceptionally stubborn and hard to bring down. Reduced penalties for fighting at low VP and for wound effects.

advantages.name: Time Sense

effects.description: Accurate internal sense of time passing; no penalties for time-dependent tests

advantages.description: The hero has an unerring sense of time, always knowing what time it is and how long things take.

advantages.name: Dwarf Nose

effects.description: A Gift (Gabe) that functions as a talent; sense underground structures, minerals, underground water, and distances below ground

advantages.description: A natural Gift for geological awareness. Functions as a talent with a starting value. The hero can sense underground structures, ore veins, and distances below ground. Primarily associated with dwarves. Can only be acquired at creation.

advantages.name: Noble Birth (wiki entry)

effects.description: The hero is the offspring of a noble family

advantages.description: The hero is the offspring of a noble family. Grants social standing and access to noble circles.

advantages.name: Two-Voiced Song

effects.description: Can produce two distinct vocal tones simultaneously; elvish singing technique

advantages.description: The ability to sing in two voices simultaneously, a distinctive elvish vocal technique. Automatic for elves; half-elves raised in elvish culture also receive this.
